scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp -r public/. dist/ && bun build src/client.js --target=browser --minify --outdir=dist
scripts.lint: bun build src/client.js --target=browser --outdir=/tmp/aegntic-assembly-check && bun build src/server.js --target=bun --external=three --outdir=/tmp/aegntic-assembly-server-check
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy
